data.text: All 64 tests pass. Now let me make the edits.

Task complete.

## Summary

I added a `## Surface` section holding `None.` to every inline proposal builder in the eight scoped test files. Since the lint rule from task 3 doesn't exist yet, the change is behavior-neutral; the goal was to make each hand-written `proposal.md` carry the section before that rule lands.

Placement followed the task rule: after `## Non-goals` where present (`scope-recertification`, `scope-resolver-upgrade`, `archive-verification`, `manifest`, `runner-scope-hashes`, `queue-watch`, `cut-over`), and at the end of the body for `runner-test-gating`'s proposal, which has no `## Non-goals`. Raw strings passed directly to `parseSpecMd`/`extractHumanSteps` are not written proposal files, so I left them alone.

Verification:
- Task verify: 64 tests, 64 pass, 0 fail.
- Proposal verify (`pnpm verify`): typechecks, build, full test suite, and biome lint all passed.

Result written to `openspec/changes/053-proposal-surface-section/.run/results/2.md`.
